method: Retrieval simulation (aiso-agent/aiso/simulate.py): 16 sample queries; BM25 retrieves the top 3 of 21 real web pages (roundups, directories, restaurant sites) and the assistant recommends restaurants in the order those pages list them. Before = today's web; after = today's web + Café Athena's new pages. Deterministic and re-runnable. A projection, not a live re-test.
